title: Remake Months and Seasonal Line Load
content:
A remake recorded in April, May or June adds 3 business days to its rebuild, and one recorded in July, August or September adds 2. In full, for Factory Production Orders, seasonal line load adds business days to the rebuild of a customer specification remake by the month of the remake:

| Month of the remake | Business days added |
|---|---|
| April, May or June | 3 |
| July, August or September | 2 |
| October through March | none |

The month is that of the date of the most recent remake on the order recorded with cause customer specification error. The days form part of the remake lead, counted in whole business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays) from the rebuild start date; the end of that lead is the remake revised ship date.

## Month edges (hypothetical remake dates)

| Remake date | Days added |
|---|---|
| 31 March | none |
| 1 April | 3 |
| 30 June | 3 |
| 1 July | 2 |
| 30 September | 2 |
| 1 October | none |

The month of the remake governs even when the rebuild itself starts in a later month.
